sources.title: ONS Environmental accounts topic page
facts: Hosts UK Environmental Accounts 2026 and related environmental-account datasets.
Residence-basis environmental accounts are not territorial parcel measurements.

sources.title: ONS UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 release
facts: Released 5 June 2026.
Links energy, atmospheric-emissions, environmental-tax and related official datasets.

sources.title: ONS UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 bulletin
facts: Reports 478 MtCO2e residence-basis greenhouse-gas emissions for 2024.
Residence basis includes UK residents and UK-registered businesses wherever activity occurs.

sources.title: ONS Measuring UK greenhouse gas emissions
facts: Last revised 7 July 2026.
Explicitly distinguishes territorial, residence/production and footprint/consumption measures.

sources.title: ONS Atmospheric emissions: greenhouse gases by industry and gas
facts: Covers greenhouse gases by industry and gas for 1990 to 2024.
Current and provisional editions have different coverage and must remain distinguished.

sources.title: ONS Atmospheric emissions GHG — current edition
facts: Current edition released 5 June 2026.
Current edition provides data for all economic sectors.

sources.title: ONS Atmospheric emissions GHG — provisional edition
facts: Provisional edition released 5 June 2026.
Provisional edition provides top-level estimates and must not be silently treated as the current full-sector edition.

sources.title: ONS Atmospheric emissions bridging tables
facts: Relates UK Environmental Accounts measures to UNFCCC and UNECE measures for 1990 to 2024.
Bridging relationships prevent silent mixing of accounting bases.

sources.title: ONS Atmospheric emissions: road transport
facts: Covers emissions from fuel sources used by UK road transport vehicles, 1990 to 2024.
National road-transport emissions are not individual-parcel measurements.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: total — current
facts: Covers direct and reallocated UK energy use by industry, 1990 to 2024.
Energy activity must not be converted to parcel emissions without validated activity and factor binding.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: bridging table
facts: Relates UK Environmental Accounts energy measures to DUKES for 1990 to 2024.
Accounting bridge is not an emissions measurement.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: bridging table — current
facts: Latest edition released 5 June 2026.
Revision history is explicitly published and must be preserved.

sources.title: ONS Environment, climate and nature insights, UK: 2026
facts: Reports UK greenhouse-gas intensity context using official statistics.
Cross-topic indicators do not establish parcel-level emissions.

sources.title: Ofgem BUS monthly scheme update
facts: Last updated 10 July 2026 with figures through 30 June 2026.
Applications, vouchers, grants and budget are scheme-administration measures, not measured GHG reductions.

sources.title: Ofgem BUS guidance for installers
facts: Version 5.1 is current for qualifying applications from 28 April 2026.
Eligible off-gas-grid grant uplift applies from 21 July 2026.

sources.title: Ofgem BUS guidance for property owners
facts: Version 5.1 is current and includes the 21 July 2026 off-gas-grid uplift guidance.
Eligibility guidance is not direct emissions observation.

sources.title: Ofgem Boiler Upgrade Scheme
facts: BUS is open in England and Wales and provides grants for eligible low-carbon heating technologies.
Grant amounts and scheme administration must remain distinct from measured carbon outcomes.

sources.title: Ofgem BUS Product Eligibility List
facts: Last updated 23 July 2026.
PEL is an administrative eligibility aid and does not guarantee overall BUS eligibility or parcel emissions performance.

sources.title: DESNZ Greenhouse gas reporting conversion factors 2026
facts: Published 11 June 2026.
Conversion factors support activity-based emissions calculations and are not direct measurements.

sources.title: DESNZ Conversion factors 2026 Code statement
facts: Published 11 June 2026.
States conversion factors are calculation tools rather than statistics themselves.

sources.title: UK ETS technical guidance and tools
facts: Collection provides monitoring, reporting and compliance guidance for UK ETS.
Country-specific 2026 emission factors are listed for annual emissions reporting; factors remain distinct from direct measurements.

sources.title: DfT Sustainable Aviation Fuel Mandate statistics collection
facts: Last updated 23 July 2026.
2025 fifth provisional release is latest; provisional figures remain subject to change before final publication.

sources.title: DfT SAF Mandate 2025 fifth provisional release
facts: Published 23 July 2026 using data available as of 8 July 2026.
Dataset is incomplete; finalised 2025 dataset is expected in November 2026.

sources.title: DfT SAF Mandate statistics data tables
facts: Updated 23 July 2026 with fifth-provisional 2025 tables.
Fuel volumes and certificates are mandate/compliance data rather than parcel emissions measurements.

sources.title: DfT Renewable Transport Fuel Obligation statistics collection
facts: Last updated 23 July 2026 and lists the 2025 fifth provisional release.
Provisional RTFO figures are indicative and remain subject to finalisation.

sources.title: DESNZ UK local authority and regional GHG emissions 2005 to 2024
facts: Published 25 June 2026 and updated 30 June 2026.
Local-authority estimates use nationally available datasets and are not individual-parcel measurements.

sources.title: DESNZ local and regional GHG statistical release — web accessible
facts: Updated 30 June 2026.
Includes methodological improvements and revisions to 2005 to 2023 data that must be preserved.

sources.title: Defra Carbon footprint for the UK and England to 2023
facts: Updated 24 July 2026.
Consumption-based footprint is distinct from territorial and residence-basis emissions; correction history must be preserved.
